description: Mineral Rights Xchange provides free, no-pressure mineral-rights education and directional underwriter assessments for U.S. owners comparing offers, inherited interests, royalties, production, and sell-or-hold decisions. Reviews use available public records, production data, owner-provided documents, and stated assumptions. They are not certified appraisals or legal, tax, title, accounting, engineering, or investment advice. MRX may be a buyer in a transaction resulting from a review and discloses that relationship in writing before an agreement is signed.
target_audience: United States mineral-rights owners and heirs who are organizing ownership records, reviewing an offer, understanding royalty or production information, or deciding whether to sell or hold.
value_proposition: MRX helps mineral-rights owners understand their records, organize a situation-specific review, and prepare questions for a Senior Underwriter without requiring a commitment to sell.
revenue_model: MRX provides education and underwriter reviews at no charge to the owner. MRX may purchase an interest after a review; any buyer relationship and transaction terms are disclosed in writing before an agreement is signed. No marketplace listing, seller commission, or fee claim is asserted by this payload.
publish_gate: A SearchAtlas or Brand Vault administrator must apply this payload after mrx_ceo/Daryl confirms the facts. No external record was modified by this repository change.
